candidate.claim: For Theorem 2, a large empty increment window creates excess discrepancy that pair correlation upper-bounds; for Theorem 3, a correlation-predicted variance remains after diagonal subtraction and therefore forces an off-diagonal nearby prime pair.
candidate.proposed_limit: The two arguments use different strengths and scale ranges of the correlation hypothesis and should not be conflated into one equivalence.
candidate.title: Large-gap bounds and close-pair existence are dual uses of prime-increment variance

parents.title: A large prime gap forces a large interval of prime-increment discrepancy

accepted_interpretation.quality_reason: Accepted because the gap-to-energy mechanism is clear despite OCR noise.

accepted_interpretation.speculation_status: No unconditional gap result is claimed; the contradiction depends on the theorem's hypotheses and readable estimates.
